rows.note: Use this for controlling or running a machine, device, or system; it is the all-purpose choice in this territory.

example.english: I still don't know how to operate this coffee machine.
example.traditional: 我仲未識操作呢部咖啡機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 sik1 cou1 zok3 ni1 bou6 gaa3 fe1 gei1

rows.note: Use this when a system, process, organization, or mechanism functions or operates by itself.

example.english: The system can operate quite smoothly.
example.jyutping: go3 hai6 tung2 wan6 zok3 dak1 gei2 seon6

rows.note: Use this specifically when a doctor performs surgery on someone.

example.english: The doctor will operate on him tomorrow.
example.traditional: 聽日醫生會幫佢做手術。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 ji1 saang1 wui5 bong1 keoi5 zou6 sau2 seot6
